component.name: Scanit
component.summary: Scan whole books on an AirScan flatbed

description.p: Scanit drives an AirScan (eSCL) flatbed scanner over the network, with no vendor driver, and is built for scanning whole books page after page.

ul.li: A quick preview that finds the book, its pages and size, and suggests the crop and type
Quick settings: colour, gray or black and white, resolution, corrections
Continuous scanning: scan, pause to turn the page, scan again until Stop
Rotation, numbered file names, and undo for every choice
